classes.ADDITIVE: No current consumer changes: a new contract, command, operation, case, policy key, or a relaxed request member.
classes.TEXT: Registry prose (precondition, effect, failure, case or requirement text); no shape changes.
classes.COORDINATED: A closed shape or vocabulary a current consumer validates gains a member or a value: the generated types, the web client and its guards are regenerated in the same change as the server (one re-issue), never one without the other.
classes.BREAKING: A current consumer breaks unless it changes its own logic: allowed only with a declared migration and the decision that accepted it.
